hooks.prompt:
End-of-turn quality gate. Detect violations in changed files. Do NOT modify any files.

STEP 1: Run `git status --porcelain`. If no changed files, respond {"ok": true}.
STEP 2: Per category, grep changed files for violations:
  - [Hardcoded color values]: Hardcoded colors (#hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch() outside var()). Must use CSS custom properties. (files: *.css,*.svelte,*.tsx,*.jsx,*.astro,*.vue) [error]
  - [TypeScript suppressions]: @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, `as any` usage. Must fix root cause. (files: *.ts,*.tsx) [error]
  - [Biome suppressions]: biome-ignore directives. Must fix the underlying issue. (files: *.ts,*.tsx,*.svelte,*.astro,*.vue) [error]
  - [Missing accessibility attributes]: Interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) missing aria-label or accessible text. (files: *.svelte,*.tsx,*.jsx,*.astro,*.vue) [warn]
  - [Missing reduced-motion]: CSS animations/transitions without prefers-reduced-motion fallback. (files: *.css,*.svelte,*.tsx,*.jsx,*.astro,*.vue) [warn]
  - [useVisibleTask$ overuse]: Overuse of useVisibleTask$ — prefer useTask$ for SSR-safe side effects. (files: *.tsx,*.ts) [warn]
  - [React useState import in Qwik]: useState import — Qwik uses useSignal/useStore, not React useState. (files: *.tsx,*.ts) [error]
  - [Unnecessary client:* directives]: Unnecessary client:* directives on static components — remove for zero-JS. (files: *.astro) [warn]
STEP 3: Overhaul audit — if user requested redesign but only superficial patches detected, report warning.

RESPONSE FORMAT: JSON only.
If no violations: {"ok": true}
If violations found: {"ok": false, "reason": "- [severity] file:line — description"}

End-of-turn quality gate for modfolio-axiom MONOREPO (Qwik City app + Astro landing).

STEP 1: Run `git status --porcelain` to identify changed files.
If no changed files, respond {"ok": true}.

Categorize by SUB-APP and TYPE:
- QWIK UI: apps/app/**/*.tsx (non-route components)
- QWIK ROUTE: apps/app/src/routes/** (route files — export default is allowed here)
- QWIK ENTRY: apps/app/src/root.tsx, apps/app/src/entry.*.tsx (framework entry — export default allowed)
- ASTRO UI: apps/landing/**/*.astro
- ASTRO TS: apps/landing/**/*.ts
- CSS: **/*.css
- API: **/+server.ts, **/plugin@*.ts
- SCHEMA: **/schema.ts, **/schema/*.ts, **/*.schema.ts
- CONFIG: package.json, *.config.*, wrangler.*

STEP 2: Per category, grep changed files for violations:

**QWIK (apps/app/) — Resumability violations are P0:**
- `import React` or `from 'react'` → P0 wrong framework
- `useEffect` / `useState` / `useRef` → P0 React anti-pattern
- `useClientEffect$` → P0 deprecated API
- `document\.querySelector` or `document\.getElement` without isServer/isBrowser guard on same or nearby line → P0 resumability violation
- `window\.` without `isBrowser` or `isServer` guard on same or nearby line → P0 resumability violation
- `addEventListener` direct call → P1 should use Qwik event handlers ($)
- Missing `component$` wrapper (function returning JSX without component$) → P1
- `useVisibleTask$` without justification comment on same or previous line → P1 eager download
- More than 3 `useVisibleTask$` in single file → P1 design review needed
- `export default` in files under apps/app/src/components/ (non-route, non-entry) → P1 use named exports
  NOTE: `export default` is ALLOWED in route files (routes/**), root.tsx, and entry.*.tsx — Qwik City requires it there.
- `onClick` without `$` suffix (`onClick={` instead of `onClick$={`) → P0 non-lazy handler
- `process.env` → P1 use requestEvent.env.get() on CF Workers
- `as any` → P2 type safety

**ASTRO (apps/landing/) — Zero-JS violations:**
- `client:load` without justification comment → P1 unnecessary JS
- More than 2 `client:load` per page → P1 JS budget exceeded
- `import React` or Qwik import in .astro → P0 framework mixing
- `<script is:inline>` without justification comment → P1 bypasses Astro bundling
  NOTE: Plain `<script>` in Astro is auto-processed as ES module — no `type="module"` needed.
- `fetch()` in frontmatter for external APIs without error handling → P2

**CSS — Token violations:**
- Hardcoded hex color (#xxx) used in a style property (NOT in a CSS variable declaration like `--custom: #hex`) → P1
- `rgb(` / `hsl(` / `oklch(` used in a style property (NOT in a variable declaration) → P1
- `!important` → P1 cascade violation
- Raw `px` values for spacing (margin/padding) not using `var(--space-*)` → P2
- `font-family:` without `var(--font-*)` → P2
- `z-index:` with magic number (not `var(--z-*)`) → P2
  NOTE: Hex values inside CSS variable declarations (e.g., `--gray-1: #1a1a2e`) are ALLOWED — they define the token system itself.

**UNIVERSAL — All files:**
- `@ts-ignore` / `@ts-expect-error` without explanation → P0 error suppression
- `biome-ignore` / `eslint-disable` → P0 lint bypass
- `as any` → P2 type safety
- Hardcoded secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords in source) → P0 security
- `console.log` in non-test files (forgotten debug) → P2

STEP 3: Check AND UPDATE memory/pattern-history.md:
- Read the existing table (it has headers: | Pattern | Count | Last Seen | Status |).
- For each violation found:
  - If pattern already exists in table: increment Count, update Last Seen to today's date.
  - If new pattern: append row `| description | 1 | YYYY-MM-DD | TRACKING |`.
- If any pattern reaches Count >= 3: change Status to `ESCALATE` and include in response.
- If no violations: do not modify the file.

STEP 4: Severity summary.
- P0 = FAIL (block)
- P1 = WARN (report, suggest fix)
- P2 = INFO (note for improvement)

RESPONSE FORMAT: You MUST respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text.
If no violations: {"ok": true}
If violations found: {"ok": false, "reason": "## Quality Gate\n\n### P0 (FAIL)\n- file:line — description\n\n### P1 (WARN)\n- file:line — description\n\n### P2 (INFO)\n- file:line — description\n\n### Escalated Patterns\n- (any pattern with count >= 3)"}

Check if architecture/design decisions were made in this turn. Look for:
- Framework choice or pattern selection
- Component structure decisions
- Token/design system changes
- Routing or data flow changes
- Performance trade-offs (e.g., choosing useVisibleTask$ over useTask$)
- Dependency additions or removals

If any decisions found, append to memory/decisions-log.md with format:

## [YYYY-MM-DD] [title]
- 결정: ...
- 근거: ...
- 대안: ...
- 선택 이유: ...
- 영향 범위: app / landing / both

RESPONSE FORMAT: You MUST respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text.
If no decisions were made: {"ok": true}
If decisions were logged: {"ok": true}
